==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will rarely use this skill.

==Notes==
* Crude Swing is a single [[attack]] that can [[hit]] multiple foes.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to attack [[kiting]] opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.

==Trivia==
*The warrior displayed on the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[Gladiator armor]] and wielding a [[Starter Hammer]] or a [[Magmas Arm]]/[[PvP Hammer]].
